pages.title: Armor and Protection
pages.text: Armor and protection from its owner's attacks, in either form. Armor stacks; owner-damage protection does not.

pages.title: Crafting the Pendant
pages.text: Place a $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/warding_emblem)Warding Emblem$(/l) and a $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/guardian_tag)Guardian Tag$(/l) anywhere in the crafting grid.
